name: Framer (framer.com marketing site + Framer plugin UI stylesheet)
licence: Proprietary. framer.com/brand lists four brand colours and logo rules only. The plugin UI stylesheet (npm framer-plugin 3.10.3, styles/framer.css) is published but the package declares no licence field (unknown). The marketing site is itself built in Framer, so its CSS is exported component styles, not a design-system token file. Study structure and values only.
bestFor: design/no-code/creative-tool brands that want a black canvas and the product as hero media
dark, high-contrast marketing with very tight display type
compact tool-panel UI (30px controls, 12px text) as in plugin windows
teams that want a tiny semantic colour contract (11 variables) for embedded UI
avoidFor: accessibility-first projects without raising the dim greys (#666 on black is 3.66:1)
teams needing an auditable token system (page tokens are UUID-named)
dense data products (no table, chart or form spec exists publicly)

families: GT Walsheim Medium (h1 and h2, weight 500, font-feature-settings "ss02"; commercial)
Inter Variable (body, nav, h3, buttons; features "cv01","cv05","cv09","cv11","ss03"; fallback sans-serif)
Input Mono Regular / Bold (code and mono labels, 31 nodes)
plugin UI: Inter (Google Fonts 100-900), system-ui, Avenir, Helvetica, Arial
declared but not used on first view: EB Garamond, Geist, Inter Tight, Mona Sans, JetBrains Mono, VT323, Luxurious Script (template/demo fonts)
typography.notes: One tracking value (-0.04em) is applied to both display sizes and scales with size; h1 line-height is 1.0, h2 1.1, h3 1.35, body 1.4. Body copy is small (14px) and mostly rgba(255,255,255,0.6). Plugin UI base is 12px/1.5 weight 500 (buttons 600), 30px controls. Measured 2026-10-08 at 1440 and 390 on framer.com, /pricing, /ai; plugin values read from framer-plugin/styles/framer.css.

neutrals.surfaces: #111111, #141414, #1a1a1a, #1e1e1e (x16), #242424 (rgb 36,36,36, x33 most common non-black fill), button plate #1f1f1f, #222 at 80% for floating chips; inverse surface #fff for primary CTA

accents.CTA: white fill, black text (primary), #1f1f1f fill with white text (secondary 'Download app')

semantic.danger / warning: unknown (no semantic names; palette has #f02 and #fb0)
semantic.note: Framer colour styles export as --token-<uuid> with no semantic name; roles are encoded only by use.

color.darkMode: Marketing site is dark-only: black canvas under both prefers-color-scheme values (measured 2026-10-08). The plugin UI supports light and dark via data-framer-theme="light|dark" plus color-scheme, with the 11 --framer-color-* variables supplied by the host; dark-specific overrides are hard-coded in the stylesheet (checkbox, select arrow, button :active #232323 vs #ddd, caret #fff).
color.contrastNotes: Computed WCAG on black: #fff 21:1, #999 7.37:1, #0099ff 7.0:1, rgba(255,255,255,0.6) renders about #999 = 7.37:1, #666 3.66:1 (below AA for text). #0099ff on white 3.0:1 (plugin links and primary button text in light theme are below AA). White on #0099ff is 3.0:1.

spacing.base: 4px (inferred from control paddings 5px/8px/10px/12px and 30/34px heights); no spacing token set exposed. Notes: Measured at 1440: content column 1200px wide (x=120..1320), nav 64px high, hero frame 1200x673 at x=120, second frame 1200x1440. CTA paddings 8px 10px (nav), 8px 12px (hero), input padding 10px, plugin control padding 0 10px, textarea 8px 10px, checkbox 12px. Gap between hero buttons about 10px. Section rhythm not tokenised; values here are measured, scale entries inferred.

radius.rule: 8px dominates (232 elements on home): nav sign-up, CTA buttons, chips, cookie buttons, plugin controls. Larger containers step up: hero frame 18px, demo cards 15 and 20px, feature frame 25px, mobile inputs 10px, pills 100px; checkbox 4px; tiny chips 3-6px. Radius grows with container size.

shadows: button highlight: rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0 10px 20px with inset rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 0 0 0 1px
depth.borders: On black, depth is hairlines at 8-12% white plus lighter surface steps (#111 to #242424); shadows are used on floating media.
depth.blur: Floating chip fill rgba(34,34,34,0.8) implies backdrop blur (radius not extracted); cookie card is opaque white.

easings: unknown for marketing (computed transition properties are empty: motion runs in JS, Framer's animation engine)
link colour transition cubic-bezier(0,0,1,1) (linear) on mobile 'Log in'
motion.notes: Computed styles on the marketing page expose almost no CSS transitions, so durations and easings cannot be audited from CSS (inferred: JS-driven springs/tweens). Hero media is autoplaying product video/animation. prefers-reduced-motion behaviour not verified.

list: plugin UI primitives: button, button-primary (.framer-button-primary), input (text, email, number, tel, password), textarea, select, checkbox, range slider, color input, file input, divider (.framer-divider)
marketing observed: nav with dropdowns, white CTA, dark secondary CTA, announcement link ('New: Skills'), media frame, plan cards, credits select, cookie card
components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Plugin UI only: button hover/focus background steps to bg-secondary, :active #ddd light / #232323 dark, :disabled opacity .5; primary hover/focus -> tint-dark, active -> tint-extra-dark (#0077ff fallback), disabled opacity .5; input focus = inset 1px tint; checkbox checked = tint; select disabled arrow lighter. No sizes or variants beyond one 30px size. Marketing component states not specified.

tokenArchitecture: Two unrelated layers. (1) Marketing site: Framer colour styles exported as --token-<uuid> custom properties (477 on the home page, e.g. --token-bd71055c-...: #09f), no semantic names, one global dark theme, text styles baked per component. (2) Plugin UI contract: 11 semantic variables with host-supplied values (--framer-color-bg/-bg-secondary/-bg-tertiary/-text/-text-secondary/-text-tertiary/-text-reversed/-divider/-tint/-tint-dark/-tint-extra-dark) plus --framer-font-family, theme switch by data-framer-theme and color-scheme. Controls are styled at the element level (button, input, select) rather than via classes, with only .framer-button-primary and .framer-divider as classes.
distinctiveness: Pure black page with white type and a single white pill-ish CTA (8px radius); display type in GT Walsheim Medium at -0.04em with line-height 1.0; body in 14px Inter at 60% white; blue held back for links; 8px everywhere with radius stepping to 18-25px on large media frames; the product (animated stills and UI) is the hero asset, not illustration; the 'agent' claim sits in a two-line headline with a small 'New: Skills' link opposite the CTAs. Generic dark sites copy the black but not the tracking, the line-height 1.0, or the 8px/25px radius step.
weaknesses: UUID-named tokens carry no meaning; a system cannot be audited or re-themed from them
#666 text on black is 3.66:1 and #09f on white is 3.0:1 (plugin links and primary button text in light theme)
computed styles hold no transition values, so motion cannot be verified from CSS and may ignore prefers-reduced-motion
at least seven fonts are declared though unused on first view (load and licensing cost)
body copy is 14px at 60% white; small for long reading
no public component library beyond a 30px plugin control kit; nothing for tables, charts, menus or dialogs
takeaways: Compress display type with a single negative tracking (-0.04em) and line-height 1.0-1.1; show how it steps down on mobile (54 to 36px, 44 to 28px)
Keep UI controls on one compact size (30px, 12px text, 8px radius, 10px padding) for tool panels; grow radius with container size (8 to 18 to 25px)
A tiny semantic contract (bg x3, text x4, divider, tint x3) is enough for embedded UI if the host supplies the values per theme
On black, build depth from white-alpha hairlines (8-12%) and surface steps (#111, #1a1a1a, #242424), reserving shadows for floating media
Make the product the hero asset and keep accent colour out of the headline; use blue only for links and signals
Do not export colours as UUIDs; name by role so the system can be audited (negative example)
Use a white primary CTA and a dark-grey secondary on black; avoid saturated CTA fills on a black canvas
Check light-theme accent text: #0099ff on white is 3.0:1; give plugin-like UIs a darker tint for text
